Selection for GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee posts is based on GATE 2027 score
followed by Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI).

GATE 2027: Eligible candidates must appear in the Electrical Engineering (EE) paper or Computer Science and Information Technology (CS) paper of GATE 2027 and qualify as per marks declared by the GATE 2027 Organizing Institute. Shortlisting for GD/PI: Qualified candidates shall be shortlisted category-wise for Group Discussion & Personal Interview based on their normalized marks (out of 100) in the corresponding GATE 2027 paper. Status can be checked via candidate login on GRID-INDIA's Online Application System. Behavioral Assessment: Candidates shortlisted for GD and PI may also have to undergo a Behavioral Assessment; its results are used only as an input during the interview and carry no qualifying marks. Group Discussion: GD carries no qualifying marks
but is mandatory to attend. Personal Interview: It is mandatory to appear in and qualify the Personal Interview for final shortlisting/empanelment.
Candidates who qualify the Personal Interview will only be adjudged suitable for empanelment. The offer of appointment will be issued in order of category-wise merit

and notified through the candidate login on the online application system. Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being found medically fit in the Pre-Employment Medical Examination conducted as per GRID-INDIA's Norms and Standards of Medical Fitness. No relaxation in GRID-INDIA's medical norms is allowed.

Appear in and qualify the Electrical Engineering (EE) paper or Computer Science and Information Technology (CS) paper of GATE 2027. Details on GATE 2027 are available at https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in.
Wait for the separate application notification to be issued on the GRID-INDIA website (https://grid-india.in) after GATE 2027 results are declared.
Register online at the GRID-INDIA website with details of your GATE 2027 Application Number, GATE 2027 Registration Number, GATE 2027 Score, and other required information.

Log in to the candidate login section and deposit the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- through online mode only (where applicable); the application process is complete only upon fee submission.
SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee.
No hard copy of the application needs to be sent to GRID-INDIA.
Keep the GATE 2027 application form, GATE 2027 Admit Card, and GATE 2027 Score Card ready for verification at the time of Group Discussion/Personal Interview/Joining at GRID-INDIA.
important_instructions: Only Indian Nationals of age 18 years or above are eligible to apply for GRID-INDIA. Essential qualification must be recognized in India and obtained from a recognized Institution or University. Candidates have the option of appearing in English or Hindi for GD/Interview. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in India and Abroad as per organizational requirement; no request for change in posting will be entertained for the first 5 years from the date of joining. Only candidates willing to serve at all GRID-INDIA locations should apply. Where CGPA/OGPA/DGPA or a Letter Grade is awarded, its equivalent percentage of marks must be indicated as per the norms adopted by the University/Institute; if no conversion scheme exists, equivalence is established by dividing the CGPA by the maximum possible CGPA and multiplying by 100. Candidates working in Government Organizations/PSUs must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview. Those unable to route their application through proper channel or produce an NOC must submit a declaration agreeing to forego carry-forward of leave, gratuity, etc., and produce a Final Relieving Letter at the time of joining. Candidates claiming OBC-NCL reservation should belong to the OBC non-creamy layer as on the last date of online submission of application. For any queries, contact [email protected]; candidates should add this email to their address book to avoid communication gaps. No correspondence on any other email or social media will be entertained. Legal jurisdiction for any cause or dispute will be NCT of Delhi. Mere appearance in GATE 2027 or submission of application to GRID-INDIA does not guarantee adequacy of candidature for further selection. Candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage if information provided is found false, misleading, or not in conformity with the notified eligibility criteria. Candidates already working in GRID-INDIA are advised to refer to the Internal Circular before filling up the application. The Management reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify, or alter the recruitment/selection process, and to raise minimum eligibility standards or conduct a screening test, without further notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Grid Controller of India Limited (GRID-INDIA), under Advertisement No. CC/26/2026 dated 16.09.2026, to fill 52 posts of Executive Trainee in the disciplines of Electrical and Computer Science, through GATE 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 52 vacancies have been announced: 37 for Executive Trainee (Electrical) - including 35 fresh and 2 backlog vacancies - and 15 for Executive Trainee (Computer Science).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee 2026?
faq.answer: No fixed application dates have been announced yet. The online application window will open only after GATE 2027 results are declared, and a separate notification will be issued on the GRID-INDIA website with the exact dates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Full Time Regular Course B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.)/IDD in the relevant discipline (Electrical/Electrical Power/Power Systems Engineering for the Electrical post; Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Information Technology for the Computer Science post) with minimum 65% marks or equivalent CGPA, along with a qualifying score in the corresponding GATE 2027 paper.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on 31.07.2027 (candidates should be born on or after 01.08.1999), with age relaxation available for OBC-NCL (3 years), SC/ST (5 years), PwBD (10 years over and above category relaxation), and Ex-Servicemen/Victims of riots as per GoI directives.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/-, payable online, non-refundable. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental candidates are exempted from payment of the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first qualify GATE 2027 in the corresponding paper, then register online at https://grid-india.in with their GATE 2027 details once the application window opens after GATE 2027 results are declared, and pay the application fee (where applicable) to complete the process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee?
faq.answer: Selection is based on GATE 2027 score (85% weightage), Group Discussion (3% weightage), and Personal Interview (12% weightage), with a minimum qualifying percentage in the interview of 40% for UR/EWS and 30% for OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD candidates.
